title: Perform Daily Preventive Maintenance Inspection on OptiSweep Operator Station
summary: Perform a daily operator-station inspection to verify the OptiSweep operator station is safe to operate by checking (1) controller condition, (2) stacklight operation, and (3) that the chute is free of debris such as stuck labels.
when_to_use: Use this daily checklist to verify the operator station is safe to operate by confirming controller condition, stacklight operation, and that the chute is free of debris (e.g., stuck labels).
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the visual inspection of the operator station controller area, stacklights, and chute for debris/stuck labels; stop and escalate if any checklist item fails.
safety_notes: This procedure is a visual inspection. Do not proceed with operation if any inspection item fails (controller damage, stacklights not operational, or debris/stuck labels in the chute).
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the OptiSweep operator station

access_required: Physical access to the OptiSweep operator station

steps.title: Inspect the operator station controller area for damage
steps.purpose: Confirm the operator station controller is not damaged before operation.
steps.instruction: Go to the OptiSweep operator station and visually inspect the controller area for damage.
steps.expected_result: No damage to the controller is observed.
steps.healthy_condition: Controller area shows no visible damage.
steps.failure_condition: Damage to the controller is observed.

actions.label: Visual inspection of controller area
actions.exact_action: Visually inspect the controller area for damage.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Inspect the operator station for the following: Damage to the controller.

steps.title: Check that the operator station stacklights are operational
steps.purpose: Confirm stacklights function so operators receive correct visual status indications.
steps.instruction: Check that the operator station stacklights are operational by observing that the stacklights function.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Inspect the operator station for the following: Stacklights are operational.

steps.title: Inspect the chute area for debris (including stuck labels)
steps.purpose: Ensure the chute is clear so packages can move without obstruction.
steps.instruction: Inspect the chute area for debris, specifically looking for stuck labels.
steps.expected_result: Chute is free of debris, including no stuck labels.
steps.healthy_condition: No debris/stuck labels are present in the chute area.
steps.failure_condition: Debris/stuck labels are found in the chute.

actions.label: Visual inspection of chute for debris
actions.exact_action: Inspect the chute area for debris, specifically looking for stuck labels.

stop_or_escalate_if: Debris/stuck labels are found in the chute.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Inspect the operator station for the following: Chute is free of debris (e.g., stuck labels).

steps.title: Stop the inspection and escalate if any checklist item fails
steps.purpose: Prevent unsafe operation when inspection criteria are not met.
steps.instruction: If any controller damage is observed, or if stacklights are not operational, or if debris/stuck labels are found in the chute, stop the daily inspection and escalate to maintenance support.
steps.expected_result: Inspection is stopped and maintenance support is escalated when any failure condition is found.
steps.healthy_condition: All three inspection items pass (no controller damage, stacklights operational, chute free of debris/stuck labels).
steps.failure_condition: Any of the three inspection items fails and escalation is not performed.

actions.label: Escalate to maintenance support
actions.exact_action: Stop the daily inspection and escalate to maintenance support.

stop_or_escalate_if: Debris/stuck labels are found in the chute.
